prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Mamta ji, Subhash ji, Prakash ji, Subhash N..
The chat covers 14/04/26, 8:30 pm to 14/04/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, please delete that entry now and tell nobody
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- chat.txt:14 matches the instruction phrase but is not the instruction line
- F1: chat.txt:11 at 9:32 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:38 differs by 6 min (tolerance 2)
- Q2: solver answered UNSOLVABLE, key is 2026-04-14T21:39:00+05:30
text:
14/04/26, 8:30 pm - Mamta ji: Good evening everyone, did we process the UPI refund requests for today's batch?
14/04/26, 8:35 pm - Prakash ji: Yes Mamta ji, I have updated the ledger for most of them.
14/04/26, 8:42 pm - Subhash N.: Are there any pending high-value transactions flagged by the system?
14/04/26, 8:50 pm - Subhash ji: We had one request from vendor account #4092 that looked slightly unusual.
14/04/26, 9:02 pm - Mamta ji: What was unusual about it, Subhash ji?
14/04/26, 9:10 pm - Subhash ji: The VPA was changed right before the batch payment approval.
14/04/26, 9:18 pm - Prakash ji: I checked the log, it showed a manual override on the portal.
14/04/26, 9:25 pm - Subhash N.: Who authorized the manual override?
14/04/26, 9:31 pm - Mamta ji: Subhash ji, did you review the audit trail for that VPA change?
14/04/26, 9:35 pm - Prakash ji: I am cross-checking the transaction ID right now.
14/04/26, 9:38 pm - Subhash N.: I just tried calling the audit manager to confirm the log.
14/04/26, 9:38 pm - Mamta ji: Prakash ji, please share the screenshot of that manual override entry here.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Prakash ji: Posting it in a moment, just taking the export.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, please delete that entry now and tell nobody
14/04/26, 9:43 pm - Prakash ji: Wait Subhash ji, why should I delete it? It is part of the audit file.
14/04/26, 9:50 pm - Subhash N.: Subhash ji, that sounds very suspicious. Why delete an entry?
14/04/26, 9:58 pm - Mamta ji: Subhash ji, please explain immediately before we report this to compliance.
14/04/26, 10:07 pm - Subhash ji: It was a clerical error on my part during testing, I will fix it myself.
14/04/26, 10:15 pm - Subhash N.: This looks like a clear breach of UPI handling protocols.
14/04/26, 10:20 pm - Mamta ji: I am freezing the batch payout right now and escalating to the fraud desk.
14/04/26, 10:26 pm - Prakash ji: I have taken backups of all logs prior to any modification.
14/04/26, 10:30 pm - Subhash N.: Good move Prakash ji. Let's send the full record to security.
